name: dsh-top100
description: Verified DeepSeek Harness plugin rankings with daily GitHub updates

scripts.update:once: npm run collect && npm run db:sync
scripts.test: npm run test -w @dsh-top100/collector && npm run test -w dsh-top100-plugin
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @dsh-top100/collector && npm run typecheck -w @dsh-top100/schema && npm run typecheck -w dsh-top100-plugin
scripts.plugin:check: npm run typecheck -w dsh-top100-plugin && npm run test -w dsh-top100-plugin
